description: GTFS pour les traverses de la Société des traversiers du Québec is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Société des traversiers du Québec. La Société des traversiers du Québec met à disposition les données General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) pour les données sur les traverses, comprenant les horaires et les parcours des navires. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Société des traversiers du Québec. Its tags are GTFS, Transport maritime, Traverse, Traverse fluviale, Traversier. It offers 1 resource(s) in GTFS. The portal shows 2025-12-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
